Hello Priya, and sorry for the worry. I can see your account here: you're on the Pro plan under priya.sharma@example.in, and you've been with us since May.

What I can't see is your payment history. The information I've been given describes who you are, not what you have paid, so I can't confirm from here whether a second charge actually went through, what it was for, or when it happened.

To answer this properly I would need your payment records: each payment on the account with its amount, its status, the order it was made against, and the exact time it was taken. If two successful payments exist for the same order within a few seconds of each other, that is a duplicate submission rather than a pending authorisation, and one of them should be returned to you. I cannot make that call myself, so once those records are available a colleague can review it with you.
